reviews.title: Account page showed wrong renewal date, charged twice (Update: Refunded)
reviews.body:
Please cancel an unused 12GB plan and refund the £6.90 charged for it.

A family member’s 12GB MSE plan renewed on 8 Nov at 07:19 (order GB_19277379). That evening the Lebara website (logged into the account) still showed “Renews on 09 Nov 2026”. Believing the plan was about to end, I turned off auto-renew on it and bought the 35GB MSE plan (order G0053860018) as its replacement. They have now paid £6.90 twice and the 12GB plan is completely unused. If the website had made it clear that the 12GB plan had already renewed that morning and was paid up until 8 Dec, I wouldn’t have bought the 35GB plan that evening.

I have a screenshot of the account page, taken at 17:09 on 8 Nov, showing “Renews on 09 Nov 2026”, ten hours after the renewal had already been charged.

I tried live chat, which ended before anyone joined, and the phone line, which hung up. I can send the screenshot and the phone number privately.

UPDATE: Thanks Nitish for getting in touch on the phone, explaining everything clearly, listening, and issuing refunds within hours. Originally I did not expect to change my review to 5 stars given initial disappointment, but they’ve resolved this faster and to a higher standard than I’d have expected. Well done.

reviews.title: Data disappearing in seconds/technical glitches/awful customer service
reviews.body:
Reposting My Review – Broken Promises, Wiped Data, and Zero Accountability
I am reposting this negative review for a second time because I made the mistake of giving Lebara another chance. Yesterday, a representative called me and begged me to delete my original Trustpilot review, promising that they would investigate my accounts and finally resolve the issue. Out of goodwill, I deleted it. Yet today, I received another email blaming me for a technical glitch that is entirely on Lebara’s end.
For the past few months, I have dealt with a massive, unresolved issue with one of accounts with Lebara. On the exact same date every single month, 10GB to 15GB of data vanishes in a matter of seconds, completely wiped off the account. Despite spending hours on the phone reporting this, nobody has been able to fix it or take responsibility.
To make matters worse, the customer service has been appalling. Instead of investigating a clear system error, which many other customers have also complained about, their representatives repeatedly insist that apps on our phones are somehow consuming 15GB of data in one second. This excuse is absurd, frustrating, and shows a complete lack of technical understanding or willingness to help. Over the last two months, I have spoken to numerous agents who were dismissive, unhelpful, and completely lacking in basic communication and customer care skills.
This is not just an inconvenience; it has caused real stress and safety concerns. On multiple occasions, my son has been left stranded without access to Google Maps to get home because his entire data allowance was wiped out instantaneously.
I am formally requesting that the Lebara team stop calling me and stop asking me to delete my Trustpilot review. I will not be making that same mistake again. Stop calling me, stop harassing me, and know that I will be taking both of my accounts elsewhere.
Lebara refuses to own up to its system failures, manipulates customers into removing honest feedback with false promises, and offers terrible support when things go wrong. Avoid signing up with this company if you want reliable service, honest communication, and a provider that actually takes responsibility for its mistakes.

reviews.title: Worst ever consumer experience
reviews.body:
I got my phone stolen (obviously very distressing in itself). New phone arrived and I went about getting a new SIM. The process for this is non-sensical. Lebara requires a call back to an alternative number at a random point in a 24 hour window. I tried giving my office number but they refused this, so I had to give my flatmate's number. Of course when they call I am not with my flatmate to give security details.

I am then told the office number is ok and they will call at 1pm - still no call! So back I go to request another time and they say they can call within the next two hours... Let's see what happens.

Can't you just have a department ready to be transferred to? I am happy to wait a bit over the phone if it doesn't mean I need to wait for an mysterious call-back which may or may not happen!

Overall just very sad and stressed as it means I won't have a usable phone for over a week:(
